vision.text:
(When you reach this level, draw a card.)
[Continuous]: Whenever you perform an attack, you may choose for that attack to deal its life card damage as stages or vice versa.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 or 2 cards from your hand. Reveal those cards instead.
POWER: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck. Banish 3 cards from your opponent's discard pile.
